reading.body:
No operator is published for this facility. The registry exhausted its search tools without identifying the entity behind the "Vital Records" name at this Somerset County address, and no website or distinguishing lead beyond the facility name appears in available sources. Without an operator identity, no specifications for power capacity, IT load, or infrastructure are available.

This facility is mapped in New Jersey, where 48 data center locations have been identified and only 5 publish power capacity figures totaling 111.3 MW across the state. The facility's rank by published megawatts cannot be determined because it publishes none.

The site cannot be assessed for relevance to AI scaling. To evaluate whether this campus matters to compute deployment, an operator identity and published specifications would be required. Future research with access to operator websites or manual verification may resolve this facility's status.
